title.zh: 为什么总是少数几家公司拿走整个市场
title.en: Why Do a Few Companies End Up Owning Whole Markets?

desc.zh: 从定价权、成本结构、寡头竞争、网络效应、双边平台、数据回路、捆绑与自我优待，到市场势力怎么测量、AI 产业链的市场结构与美国、欧盟、中国的反垄断现状。十二个可以拖动的产业组织模型，前沿事实都标了日期和出处。
desc.en: Pricing power, cost structure, oligopoly, network effects, two-sided platforms, data loops, tying and self-preferencing, then how market power is measured, the market structure of the AI stack, and antitrust in the US, EU and China. Twelve industrial-organisation models you can drag, with every frontier fact dated and sourced.

title.en: Monopoly pricing and the Lerner index

desc.zh: 能定价的卖家卖到边际收入等于边际成本为止；加价率 (P − MC)/P = 1/ε，完全由它面对的需求弹性决定，并留下无谓损失。
desc.en: A price-setting seller produces until marginal revenue equals marginal cost; the markup (P − MC)/P = 1/ε is fixed by the elasticity it faces, and leaves a deadweight loss.

zh: 边际收入等于边际成本

title.zh: 最小有效规模与自然垄断
title.en: Minimum efficient scale and natural monopoly

desc.zh: 固定成本大、边际成本小的行业，最小有效规模相对市场很大，只容得下几家；市场小于约 1.41 倍最小有效规模时一家最省钱。
desc.en: Where fixed costs are large and marginal costs small, minimum efficient scale is large relative to the market, so only a few firms fit; below about 1.41 × MES one firm is cheapest.

zh: 为什么芯片行业只有几家
为什么软件公司容易垄断
为什么自来水公司只有一家
en: why are there so few chip makers

title.zh: 寡头竞争：古诺、伯特兰与 HHI
title.en: Oligopoly: Cournot, Bertrand and the HHI

desc.zh: 同样是两家，拼产量时价格接近垄断，同质拼价格时等于成本，产品有差异时介于两者。HHI 相同，竞争强度可以完全不同。
desc.en: With two firms, quantity competition keeps prices near monopoly, price competition in identical goods drives them to cost, differentiation sits between. The same HHI can hide very different competition.

zh: 两家公司会不会合谋涨价

title.zh: 自由进入、沉没成本与可竞争市场
title.en: Free entry, sunk costs and contestable markets

desc.zh: 家数是均衡的结果：竞争越狠，进入后越难赚回沉没成本，行业反而越集中；古诺自由进入往往进入过度；进入成本可收回时一家也只能收平均成本。
desc.en: The number of firms is an equilibrium: fiercer competition makes sunk costs harder to recover, so the industry ends up more concentrated; Cournot free entry tends to overshoot; with recoverable entry costs even a lone firm prices at average cost.

zh: 一个市场能养活几家公司
为什么价格战之后只剩一家
en: how many firms can a market support

desc.zh: 价值来自别人也在用时，需求曲线呈驼峰形 p = n(1 − n)：低于临界规模塌回零，越过它自己长大。
desc.en: When value comes from others using it, demand is hump-shaped, p = n(1 − n): below critical mass the network collapses, above it grows on its own.

zh: 为什么新平台要烧钱补贴

title.zh: 锁定、路径依赖与转换成本
title.en: Lock-in, path dependence and switching costs

desc.zh: Arthur（1989）模型：两个标准竞争时，领先一旦超过 g/r 人就锁定；会有一个赢家几乎必然，谁赢几乎是抛硬币。
desc.en: Arthur (1989): when two standards compete, a lead larger than g/r users locks in; that someone wins is near certain, who wins is close to a coin toss.

zh: 为什么更好的产品不一定赢
en: why the better product doesn't always win

title.zh: 双边平台定价与竞争瓶颈
title.en: Two-sided platform pricing and the competitive bottleneck

desc.zh: 平台每一边的价格 = 成本 + 普通加价 − 这一边带给另一边的价值；被更需要的一边被补贴，只看一边价格会看错。
desc.en: On a platform each side's price = cost + the usual markup − the value that side brings the other; the side that is needed more gets subsidised, and one side's price alone misleads.

zh: 为什么外卖平台抽成高

title.en: Data feedback loops and learning curves

desc.zh: 用户带来数据、数据改善产品：数据回报递减时领先会自己消退；只有数据过时得够快时，回路才把领先变成一家通吃。
desc.en: Users bring data and data improves the product: with diminishing returns a data lead fades; only when data goes stale fast enough does the loop turn a lead into winner-take-all.

zh: 有数据的公司一定赢吗
AI 公司为什么要用户数据

title.zh: 捆绑、自我优待与纵向一体化

desc.zh: 单一垄断利润论在什么时候失效（Whinston 1990）：被绑产品有独立买家、对手需要规模时，捆绑能挤走更好的对手；纵向合并也能消除双重加价。
desc.en: When the one-monopoly-profit argument fails (Whinston 1990): if the tied good has independent buyers and the rival needs scale, tying can exclude a better rival; vertical mergers can also remove double marginalisation.

zh: 平台把自家产品排前面违法吗

title.zh: 互通、多归属：赢家通吃不是必然
title.en: Interoperability and multi-homing: winner-take-all is not inevitable

desc.zh: 锁定门槛是 g/(r(1 − φ))：互通、多归属和真实的口味差异都能让网络效应下的一边倒消失。
desc.en: The lock-in threshold is g/(r(1 − φ)): interoperability, multi-homing and genuine taste differences can each make network-effect tipping disappear.

zh: 为什么邮箱没有被一家垄断

title.zh: 测量市场势力与反垄断的几派立场
title.en: Measuring market power and the antitrust schools

desc.zh: De Loecker–Eeckhout–Unger 的加价估计与 Traina、Bond 等人的批评；集中度不等于势力（Demsetz）；芝加哥、后芝加哥、新布兰代斯三种立场并列。
desc.en: The De Loecker–Eeckhout–Unger markup estimates and the critiques by Traina and Bond et al.; concentration is not power (Demsetz); the Chicago, post-Chicago and neo-Brandeisian positions side by side.

en: is concentration the same as monopoly

title.zh: AI 产业链的市场结构与各地反垄断
title.en: Market structure of the AI stack and antitrust worldwide

desc.zh: 芯片、云、模型、应用四层各自的集中度和机制，以及截至 2026-11-11 美国、欧盟、中国的主要案件和规则，全部带日期和出处。
desc.en: Concentration and mechanisms in chips, cloud, models and apps, and the main US, EU and China cases and rules as of 2026-11-11, all dated and sourced.
